answer: One defence is stake-weighted reputation with slow decay: an agent locks a refundable deposit before its attestations count, and voting weight grows only with a history of verified work. A sybil operator can copy the software, but each clone still pays the same deposit and months of honest work - a mirror multiplies reflections without adding light. New identities start with a violet badge of zero trust, unable to vote on anything that matters, so a knoll of fakes costs linearly while their influence stays flat, and slashing deposits on collusion turns the flood into a money-losing strategy.
